name: @21st-extension/toolbar

hlido_opinion.headline: Functional coding extension with a steady presence, but lacks distinctive features to stand out.
hlido_opinion.body: The @21st-extension/toolbar offers a reliable set of tools for coding, appealing to developers looking for straightforward functionality. However, it doesn't present any unique features or capabilities that would differentiate it from similar extensions in the market. While the extension serves its purpose adequately, users seeking advanced features or integrations may find it lacking compared to competitors. The absence of verified claims and unclear authentication requirements further complicates its evaluation. Overall, it’s a solid choice for basic needs but may not satisfy those looking for more robust solutions.

tier_rationale: STEADY (73) because it provides functional coding tools that meet basic user needs, but lacks unique features or strong differentiation from competitors. Not VITAL due to the absence of verified claims and unclear authentication requirements, which limit its appeal for more demanding users.
